A vertical heat exchanger for a pressurized core.
# Building it
A square box of Steam Generator Casing 3 to 7 blocks across and 4 to 12 tall, the controller in a wall, Steam Generator Tubes inside (the rest may be air).

# Running it
Hot Coolant (or Hot Heavy Water) and feedwater come in through Input ports. Each tube block cools up to 200 mB of hot coolant a tick; each mB carries 60 HU, which boils feedwater into High-Pressure Steam (12 HU a mB) for the Steam Turbine Arrays. The cooled coolant goes back out of Output ports to the reactor, steam out of Steam ports.
